item.title: Afghan Taliban mortar fire kills 1 civilian, wounds 5 in northwest Pakistan border clash
item.description: A Pakistani official says the Afghan Taliban have fired mortars into a former stronghold of the Pakistani Taliban in restive northwestern Pakistan, killing one civilian and wounding five others.

item.title: King Charles III arrives in Bahamas for official Caribbean trip as slavery reparation demands grow
item.description: King Charles III has arrived in the Bahamas as part of a nine-day trip to the Caribbean, where he faces calls for an apology and slavery reparations.

item.title: Construction Of Military Data Center On Maui Alarms Residents
item.description: The controversial telescopes that the military is seeking to build in a state conservation district atop Haleakalā would be remotely operated from a two-story, 56,000-square-foot laboratory and data center that is currently under construction in Kīhei.

item.title: Trump plans to loosen restrictions on methane emissions from oil drilling
item.description: President Donald Trump is expected to announce plans to loosen a Biden-era rule that aimed to reduce planet-warming emissions of methane from oil and gas drilling.
